name: Nasdaq risk-appetite lead-lag — long crypto momentum confirmed by a rising NDX
rationale: Crypto's strongest cross-asset beta is to the high-beta tech/liquidity factor, which the Nasdaq-100 (ndx_index) carries more cleanly than the broad S&P. Equities close ~21h before the next crypto day rolls over, so a daily NDX close is a point-in-time, next-day-available read on the global risk-appetite REGIME that conditions crypto's drift — and because equities and crypto trade on different clocks, NDX can LEAD intraday-to-daily crypto moves rather than merely co-move with them. This is the macro analog of the BTC->alt social-contagion lead-lag, but the leader is the equity risk factor, not BTC's crowd. The hypothesis: take long crypto momentum (ret_Nd positive) ONLY when the Nasdaq risk backdrop is itself rising (ndx_index cross_up through a fitted level — risk-on confirmed by the asset class crypto co-moves with most) — the macro gate filters out crypto momentum that fires into a risk-OFF equity tape, which is exactly when crypto momentum decays into a drawdown. Exit when NDX rolls over (ndx_index cross_down — the risk-on regime that was supporting the trade has turned) or risk limits hit. Spot-only LONG (direction=+1); NDX is a read-only cross-asset regime feature, no funding leg. Disconfirmer 1: the edge must be the NDX gate adding regime information OVER crypto's own price. If dropping the ndx_index conditions and keeping only ret_Nd momentum yields an equal-or-better deflated Sharpe, the macro gate is redundant with crypto's own momentum (crypto already reflects the same risk regime) and the lead-lag claim is false. Disconfirmer 2: if a DXY (dollar) or SPX gate does materially better than NDX on the same setup, the specific 'Nasdaq tech-beta leads crypto' thesis is wrong — the edge (if any) is a generic macro-risk gate, not the tech factor in particular. tier0 macro feature; the COMBINATION is unproven — low-confidence until validated OOS.
catalyst: ndx_index turns up (risk-on confirmed by the equity tech factor crypto co-moves with) WHILE crypto price momentum is positive.
